name: CApp_Constructor
summary: Constructs CApp: stores CApp_vtbl, duplicates two strings and the data-manager version string, installs a low-level keyboard hook, resets g_pCamera and creates g_pEnv.
evidence: Stores &CApp_vtbl into *this and returns this; SetWindowsHookExA(13=WH_KEYBOARD_LL); 'Version Error' fallback string; CEnv_Constructor; called from the CDx/CApp creation routine 0x100161B0.

name: App_ForceForegroundWindow
summary: Forces the game window to the foreground: attaches thread input, temporarily zeroes the foreground lock timeout, calls SetForegroundWindow and restores the timeout; skipped unless window mode is 0.
evidence: AttachThreadInput + SystemParametersInfoA(0x2000 SPI_GETFOREGROUNDLOCKTIMEOUT / 0x2001 SPI_SETFOREGROUNDLOCKTIMEOUT) + SetForegroundWindow. It is gated on g_timeOfDayTintEnabled==0, but that global is the window-mode value (see 0x100165B0), not a tint flag.

name: CApp_RunMainLoop
summary: CApp main loop: initialises CDx and input, creates the app/camera object, runs App_InitScene until done, then pumps PeekMessage and renders frames until WM_QUIT, finally running shutdown.
evidence: Member of CApp; CDx_Initialize; App_Constructor (0x33C bytes) -> g_pCamera; PeekMessageA/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageA loop; exits on msg 18 (WM_QUIT); VK_SNAPSHOT (44) on WM_KEYUP/WM_SYSKEYDOWN copies a string to the clipboard; calls 0x10001B50 (render) each loop.

name: App_PreTranslateInputMessage
summary: Per-message input pre-handler called before TranslateMessage: forwards IME messages (0x10F, 0x281-0x283), WM_CHAR/WM_ACTIVATE/WM_KEYDOWN to the input and IME objects and mouse messages (0x200-0x20A) to the mouse handler, with client-area coordinate scaling.
evidence: Switch on message ids 0x102, 6, 0x100 (with VK 229/ImmGetVirtualKey), 0x10F, 0x281-0x283, 0x200-0x20A (mouse buttons/wheel to dword_104E1D4C handlers); GetWindowRect + GetSystemMetrics(32/33/4) frame correction; only caller is CApp_RunMainLoop before TranslateMessage.

name: App_RenderFrameMaskedFPU
summary: Masks all FPU exceptions, calls Frame_Render(g_pCamera), restores the FPU control word, and on success runs an update on off_103601BC; returns success.
evidence: _control87(0x8001F,0x8001F) around Frame_Render(g_pCamera); called from CApp_RunMainLoop and the window proc 0x10016870.

name: App_CreateInputSystem
summary: Allocates a 0xDC4-byte input object into dword_10455C20, constructs it and initialises it with the HINSTANCE.
evidence: Allocator_Generic(0xDC4); ctor 0x10005660 zeroes two 256-byte key-state buffers; init 0x100058F0 takes the HINSTANCE (as DirectInput creation does); dword_10455C20 receives WM_CHAR/WM_ACTIVATE in App_PreTranslateInputMessage; neighbouring unit is DirectInput.

name: CApp_CopyTextToClipboard
summary: Copies a string to the Windows clipboard as CF_TEXT using the app's HWND.
evidence: GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE|GMEM_DDESHARE)/lstrcpyA/OpenClipboard(this->hwnd at +0x18)/EmptyClipboard/SetClipboardData(1=CF_TEXT); called on the PrintScreen key in CApp_RunMainLoop.

name: App_SetCommandLine
summary: Stores a heap copy of the given string in dword_103D3C88 (the command line), returning 0 on allocation failure.
evidence: Duplicates its argument into dword_103D3C88; sub_10001F40 (via 0x10001F20) searches dword_103D3C88 for '-<opt>' switches such as '-%ssound', so it is the command-line buffer.

name: App_FreeCommandLine
summary: Frees the command-line copy in dword_103D3C88 and clears it.
evidence: operator_delete(dword_103D3C88); pairs with App_SetCommandLine (0x10001E00); both are called from the startup/shutdown routine 0x100157E0.

name: Gfx_CopySurfaceRectToTexture
summary: Creates a texture the size of a rect (falling back to 512x512), copies a source-surface region into level 0 with D3DXLoadSurfaceFromSurface, passes the surface to a follow-up routine, then releases everything.
evidence: CDx_CreateTexture(w,h) with 0x200 fallback; texture vtbl+60 GetSurfaceLevel(0); D3DXLoadSurfaceFromSurface(...,filter 3); then Gfx_ProbeDeviceCaps(surface,a3,rect). That callee name looks wrong for this use (it takes a surface and a rect).

name: App_DetectDat11
summary: If 11.DAT exists in the current directory, sets dword_103D3C8C to 11.
evidence: Calls 0x10002480, which fopen()s GetCurrentDirectory+'\\11.DAT'; on success stores 11 in dword_103D3C8C; called during startup (0x100157E0).

name: App_CreateConfig
summary: Creates the 0xB4-byte startup config object (dword_103D3CB8) and turns sound off (dword_10456A88=0) if the '-<id>sound' command-line switch contains 'off'.
evidence: Allocator_Generic(0xB4) + ctor 0x10002790 -> dword_103D3CB8; sprintf '-%ssound'; command-line lookup 0x10001F20 + strstr 'off'; Frame_Render and startup read dword_103D3CB8 fields +32/+36/+40/+88/+96 as settings; dword_10456A88 gates sound init.

name: App_DestroyConfig
summary: Destroys the config object dword_103D3CB8 through its virtual deleting destructor and clears the pointer.
evidence: vtbl[0](obj,1) scalar-delete on dword_103D3CB8; called at the end of startup/shutdown 0x100157E0; pairs with App_CreateConfig.

name: Gfx_IsGammaSupported
summary: Returns CDx byte +0x915 (0 if there is no CDx); the flag that gates gamma-ramp save and restore.
evidence: Returns g_pCDx->_pad_10[2309]; CXiOpening ctor/dtor check the same flag before saving/forcing/restoring the gamma RGB at CDx gamma object (+0x1F4).

name: Gfx_SetGammaRGB
summary: Sets the R/G/B gamma values of the CDx gamma-ramp object.
evidence: Calls 0x100170A0 (stores 3 floats at +1540..1548) on g_pCDx->_pad_10[484]; 0x10017230 rebuilds the ramp from these and calls SetGammaRamp; CXiOpening sets them to 1.0f during the opening.

name: Gfx_SetGammaR
summary: Sets only the red gamma component, keeping green and blue.
evidence: Reads the current triple with 0x100170D0, replaces the first, and writes it back via Gfx_SetGammaRGB (0x10002C00); called from options code 0x101AA650.

name: Gfx_SetGammaG
summary: Sets only the green gamma component, keeping red and blue.
evidence: Same pattern as Gfx_SetGammaR, replacing the second value.

name: Gfx_SetGammaB
summary: Sets only the blue gamma component, keeping red and green.
evidence: Same pattern as Gfx_SetGammaR, replacing the third value.

name: Gfx_GetGammaRGB
summary: Reads the three gamma components into the caller's out-pointers.
evidence: Calls 0x100170D0 on g_pCDx->_pad_10[484] (reads +1540..1548); no callers recorded.

summary: Returns 1.0 if byte_10487EF5 is set, otherwise returns the float global flt_10456A68.
evidence: The body is `byte_10487EF5 ? 1.0 : flt_10456A68` (0x10087110 returns byte_10487EF5); callers are blend-weight and distortion-mesh code, so it is a global scale factor, but the meaning of the flag is unknown.

name: Gfx_DestroyD3DHolder
summary: Releases and deletes g_pD3DHolder through its virtual deleting destructor and clears it.
evidence: Calls vtbl[0](g_pD3DHolder,1) and sets g_pD3DHolder = nullptr; called on startup failure and shutdown in 0x100157E0.

name: D3DHolder_Constructor
summary: Constructs a D3DHolder: sets the vtable and zeroes the D3D/device pointers and the 0x42C-byte adapter-identifier buffer.
evidence: Stores off_1032963C; memset(this+0x48, 0, 0x42C) (0x42C = sizeof D3DADAPTER_IDENTIFIER8); only caller is Gfx_CreateD3DHolder.

name: D3DHolder_Initialize
summary: Runs Gfx_D3DBootstrap; on success queries GetAdapterIdentifier(0, D3DENUM_NO_WHQL_LEVEL) into this+0x48. On failure sets error code 2000 or 2001 depending on device caps.
evidence: IDirect3D8 vtbl+20 = GetAdapterIdentifier(adapter 0, flags 2, this+18 dwords); App_SetErrorCode(2000/2001) checks caps bits 0x80000/0x10000; caller is Gfx_CreateD3DHolder.

name: D3DHolder_CheckDepthFormat
summary: Checks that a depth-stencil format is usable with the given adapter/render-target formats on adapter 0 HAL.
evidence: IDirect3D8 vtbl+40 CheckDeviceFormat(0, HAL, adapterFmt, D3DUSAGE_DEPTHSTENCIL, D3DRTYPE_SURFACE, depthFmt) && vtbl+48 CheckDepthStencilMatch(0, HAL, adapterFmt, rtFmt, depthFmt); caller is Gfx_TryCreateDeviceForMode.

name: Debug_DrawTextTable
summary: Sets up alpha-blended, fog-off text render states, then draws each active entry of a 2304-entry debug text table with 0x10003D70, and restores the Z states.
evidence: SetRenderState FOGENABLE 0, ALPHABLEND SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA, MODULATE stage 0; loop over 18432/8 entries skipping id -1, passing a 16-byte matrix/position, a 1024-byte string and a dword; reconstructed as Debug.cpp.

name: Debug_DrawWorldText
summary: Draws a text string as textured glyph quads at a given world transform: builds the world matrix, looks up glyphs in font dword_104E1BF8, handles newlines, and calls DrawPrimitiveUP.
evidence: CDx_SetTransform(256 = D3DTS_WORLD); per-character glyph lookup with 0x10120510 on dword_104E1BF8; newline (10) moves 8 units down; CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP; 'Error %s %d' string; only caller is Debug_DrawTextTable. The provisional name Dev_SetVertexShader only reflects one call.

name: CDx_Destructor
summary: CDx destructor body: restores CDx_vtbl, deletes two state blocks, releases stereo resources, and destroys member sub-objects (CAcc array, etc.).
evidence: Stores &CDx_vtbl; device vtbl+224 = DeleteStateBlock for handles at +492/+496 (skips 0/-1); CDx_ReleaseStereoResources; CAcc_Destructor x4; caller is CDx_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CDx_SetDefaultRenderTargets
summary: Stores the default back-buffer and depth-stencil surfaces in CDx (+0x90/+0x94) and returns 1.
evidence: Caller 0x100161B0 passes GetBackBuffer and GetDepthStencilSurface results; CDx_PopRenderTarget (0x1000A2B0) restores exactly these two fields (+144/+148) at stack depth 0.

name: CDx_SetClearParams
summary: Stores Clear() parameters (flags, color, Z, stencil) in CDx fields +0x164..+0x170.
evidence: Every caller passes (3 = D3DCLEAR_TARGET|ZBUFFER, 0x80000000, 1.0f, 0), which matches the IDirect3DDevice8::Clear argument order; 0x10009670 updates only the colour slot.

name: CDx_SetClearColor
summary: Sets only the stored clear colour (CDx +0x168).
evidence: Writes the second slot that CDx_SetClearParams (0x10009640) fills; Frame_Render and the state-5 step pass 0x80000000.

name: CDx_ShowCursor
summary: Shows or hides the mouse cursor: uses IDirect3DDevice8::ShowCursor when a hardware cursor is active, otherwise SetCursor(NULL), depending on window mode.
evidence: Device vtbl+48 = ShowCursor(bShow) when dword_10456BF8 is set; else SetCursor(nullptr) with a special case for window mode 3; callers are DirectInput_InstallMouse and the mouse handlers.

name: CDx_SetCursorShape
summary: When the hardware cursor is enabled, maps a cursor state (0-6) to one of the cached HCURSOR slots at CDx+0xA04, loading IDC_ARROW on first use, and calls SetCursor.
evidence: Switch on a2 picks slot 0/1, or asks 0x101245C0; LoadCursorA(NULL, 0x7F00 = IDC_ARROW); SetCursor; gated by dword_10456BF8; callers are mouse code 0x10124EB0/0x101252F0.

name: CDx_PopRenderTargetDefault
summary: Calls CDx_PopRenderTarget (0x1000A2B0) with the extra two arguments set to 1.
evidence: Body is `return sub_1000A2B0(this, a2, a3, 1, 1)`.

name: CDx_PopRenderTarget
summary: Pops the CDx render-target stack: decrements the depth byte, rebinds the previous colour target (texture surface level 0 or surface) and depth surface, or the defaults at depth 0, then restores the saved viewport.
evidence: Byte at +344 decremented; texture vtbl+60 GetSurfaceLevel; device vtbl+124 = SetRenderTarget(surf, depth); vtbl+160 = SetViewport(this+152+24*depth) (24 = sizeof D3DVIEWPORT8); counterpart of CDx_PushRenderTarget.

name: CDx_DrawTextureToViewport
summary: Draws a texture (for example the scene render target) as a screen quad covering the current viewport, with full UVs and the given diffuse colour.
evidence: Copies the viewport rect for the current stack depth (+152+24*depth) and calls 0x1000A550 (UV 0..1) -> 0x1000A5A0; Frame_Render calls it with CDx render-target texture _pad_10[388] and colour 0x80808080; callers include Post_Afterimage.

name: CDx_DrawTexturedScreenQuad
summary: Draws a pre-transformed textured quad: builds 4 XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1 vertices from a pixel rect (with -0.5 offset), UV rect and colour, binds the texture to stage 0 and draws a triangle strip.
evidence: Device vtbl+244 = SetTexture(0, tex); vtbl+304 = SetVertexShader(324 = 0x144 FVF XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1); CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(5 = TRIANGLESTRIP, 2, verts, 28).

name: CDx_PushRenderTargetRet1
summary: Calls CDx_PushRenderTarget with the same arguments and returns 1.
evidence: Body is `CDx_PushRenderTarget(this,a2,a3,a4); return 1;`; Frame_Render uses it to bind the scene render target.

name: CDx_CreateDepthSurfaceLikeMain
summary: Creates a depth-stencil surface of the requested size using the format and multisample type of CDx's main depth surface; returns it or 0.
evidence: Surface vtbl+32 = GetDesc on this+0x94 (default depth surface); device vtbl+104 = CreateDepthStencilSurface(w, h, desc.Format, desc.MultiSampleType, &out).

name: CDx_StepFadeCounter
summary: Fade counter at CDx+0x174: mode 0 resets it to 128.0; mode 1 subtracts a2*a3 (minimum 0.01) and returns 1 once it reaches 0.
evidence: Float at this[93]; constants 128.0 and 0.0099999998; called from Frame_Render and the state-10 step 0x100141C0 with (0,0,1).

name: CAcc2_Constructor
summary: Constructs a CAcc2 object: sets CAcc2_vtbl and zeroes six fields.
evidence: Stores &CAcc2_vtbl into *this, returns this; called from CDx_Constructor.

name: App_RegisterSystemDats
summary: Registers about 18 named system DAT resources (IS/IS2, BS, CL, TI, MB, SB, SK, CA, WR..WR8, B2) with their handles through 0x1021C070, then sets flag bit 2 on dword_104E0AF4.
evidence: Strings aIsDat/aIs2Dat/aBsDat/.../aWr8Dat/aB2Dat paired with slot indices 0-17; called from the zone-in sequence steps (0x10013DF0, 0x10014030, 0x10014120).

name: App_SetSeqStep
summary: Sets the sequence step (word +4) and clears the sub-counter (word +6).
evidence: Frame_Render calls it with 0 whenever the game state (+68) changes; App_AdvanceSeqStep (0x10010D00) increments the same word.

name: App_AdvanceSeqStep
summary: Increments the sequence step word (+4) and clears the sub-counter (+6).
evidence: `++this[2]; this[3]=0;` on WORDs; used after each completed case in the step switches 0x10013AD0/0x10013DF0/etc.

name: App_StepGameState5Connect
summary: Step function for Frame_Render game state 5: sets up fog render states, initialises game systems and starts the lobby thread, polls the connection (updating the zone map around the player), then runs a 60-frame countdown before finishing.
evidence: Case 0: D3DRS_FOGCOLOR/FOGVERTEXMODE/FOGTABLEMODE/RANGEFOGENABLE/FOGSTART/FOGEND, GameSystems_InitializeAll, LobbyThread_Start; case 1: g_pZoneMap updates and the 0x10245B60 result (-2 -> error); Frame_Render calls it in state 5.

name: App_StepGameState6
summary: Frame_Render state-6 sequence: registers system DATs, loads the 'menu chdummy' resource, sets clear params, resets game data, then issues requests 6, 7 and 9 to off_103601BC, waiting for each to finish (>200 = failure).
evidence: Strings aMenuChdummy; App_RegisterSystemDats; CDx_SetClearParams(3,0x80000000,1.0,0); 0x100DB170(obj,6/7/9) then poll 0x100DB140 (100 = idle); Frame_Render state 6 -> 10.

name: App_StepGameState7
summary: Frame_Render state-7 sequence: like state 6 but without the DAT registration, issuing requests 6, 8 and 9.
evidence: Same structure as 0x10013DF0 with 0x100DB170(...,8) instead of 7 and no App_RegisterSystemDats; Frame_Render state 7.

name: App_StepGameState8
summary: Frame_Render state-8 sequence: registers DATs and resets data like state 6, skips request 6, then issues requests 8 and 9.
evidence: Cases 1-2 jump straight to the next step; 0x100DB170(...,8/9); Frame_Render state 8.

name: App_StepGameState9
summary: Frame_Render state-9 action: registers DATs, loads 'menu chdummy', sets clear params and resets game data in one call; returns the reset result.
evidence: Same case-0 body as 0x10013DF0 with no server requests; Frame_Render state 9 -> 10.

summary: Substep of the state-10 handler: copies config+8 (+1) into word_104568F8, ticks the CDx fade counter and advances the sequence step.
evidence: dword_103D3CB8+8 -> word_104568F8; CDx_StepFadeCounter(g_pCDx,0,0,1); App_AdvanceSeqStep; only caller is 0x10014170 (Frame_Render state 0xA). The purpose of word_104568F8 is unknown.

summary: Shutdown or teardown helper run when the main loop exits: calls several subsystem routines and returns true only if two later checks succeed.
evidence: Callees 0x1019C4F0, 0x10251620(self,0..), 0x10029B60, 0x10093B70, 0x10014C60, 0x10152FA0, none of them identified; called at the end of CApp_RunMainLoop and from 0x100013C0.

name: Camera_GetFrameScale
summary: Returns the float at g_pCamera+0x28, clamped to a minimum of 1.0.
evidence: `max(*(float*)(g_pCamera+40), 1.0)`; 112 callers including CYyMotionQue_ComputeFrameAdvance and DirectInput_ApplyRumble, so it is likely the elapsed-frames/time multiplier.

name: Camera_GetFloat2DC
summary: Returns the float at g_pCamera+0x2DC.
evidence: `return ((float*)g_pCamera)[183]`.

name: Camera_GetFloat2E0
summary: Returns the float at g_pCamera+0x2E0.
evidence: `return ((float*)g_pCamera)[184]`.

name: Camera_SetClearColorRGB
summary: Sets g_pCamera's background clear colour (+0x308) from r,g,b bytes with alpha 0x80.
evidence: Forwards to 0x10014DB0, which stores 0x80RRGGBB-style packing at this[194]; Frame_Render passes *((DWORD*)G_106693FC+194) as the Clear colour.

name: Camera_SetViewMatrix
summary: Passes a 4x4 matrix by value to 0x10015120 on g_pCamera, which copies it into several matrix slots (+0x54/+0x94/+0xD4), resets a vector and builds a derived matrix at +0x294.
evidence: Forwards 16 dwords to 0x10015120 (Mat4_Copy x4, 0x100279B0 identity, 0x100283C0); caller is Camera_ApplyViewProjection. 'View' is inferred.

name: Camera_SetMatrix154
summary: Passes a 4x4 matrix by value into g_pCamera+0x154.
evidence: Forwards 16 dwords to 0x100151D0 = Mat4_Copy(this+85); Camera_GetMatrix154Ptr (0x10015270) returns the same slot; caller is 0x1024F900.

name: Camera_GetViewMatrixPtr
summary: Returns a pointer to the matrix at g_pCamera+0x94.
evidence: `return g_pCamera+148`; 0x10015120 (Camera_SetViewMatrix) writes this slot.

name: Camera_GetField50
summary: Returns the dword at g_pCamera+0x50.
evidence: `return ((DWORD*)g_pCamera)[20]`; 44 callers.

name: Camera_GetMatrix154Ptr
summary: Returns a pointer to the matrix at g_pCamera+0x154.
evidence: `return g_pCamera+340`; filled by Camera_SetMatrix154.

name: App_WinMain
summary: Process-level startup and shutdown: reads the command line and config, picks the data path, checks the OS, creates the 'FinalFantasyXI' window, IME/keyinput DLLs and D3D holder (retrying), inits sound and runs the app, then tears everything down in reverse.
evidence: App_SetCommandLine, App_CreateConfig, App_InitDataPaths, App_CheckOSVersion, App_CreateMainWindow('FinalFantasyXI'), Gfx_CreateD3DHolder (fallback retry), App_InitSoundSystem, 0x10015AB0; cleanup Gfx_DestroyD3DHolder, App_DestroyMainWindow, App_DestroyConfig, App_FreeCommandLine.

name: App_RunWithCOM
summary: Sets the process priority class, masks the FPU, calls CoInitialize, creates a helper object, creates the renderer/app and runs it, then cleans up and calls CoUninitialize.
evidence: SetPriorityClass (class chosen from dword_10456AAC); _control87(0x8001F); CoInitialize/CoUninitialize; App_CreateRendererAndApp (0x100161B0) then 0x10016300 (run).

name: App_InitDataPaths
summary: Creates the data/ROM path manager (dword_10662DCC) according to the install mode in the config: current directory, the registry path, or the dev path 'C:\image\ffxi\config\data'.
evidence: Switch on dword_103D3CB8+32 (1-4); 0x101C4530 ctor with modes; GetCurrentDirectoryA; '%s\\%s' join list; CApp_Constructor later gets the version string from dword_10662DCC.

name: App_DestroyDataPaths
summary: Shuts down and deletes the data path manager dword_10662DCC.
evidence: 0x101C4680 then vtbl[0](obj,1) and clear; called at shutdown in App_WinMain; pairs with App_InitDataPaths.

name: App_CheckOSVersion
summary: Requires Windows 98 or later (4.10) or NT 5.0 or later via 0x10015FC0, plus a second check; sets error 6 or 7 and returns 0 on failure.
evidence: 0x10015FC0(4,10,5,0,0) uses GetVersionExA (platform 1: >=4.10; platform 2: >=5.0 SP0); App_SetErrorCode(6/7). The second check is mislabelled as std::codecvt_base::do_always_noconv.

name: App_IsRegistryFlagSet
summary: Opens an HKLM key chosen by index (0-2) from the lpSubKey table and returns true if its DWORD value named by a0001 is nonzero.
evidence: RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, (&lpSubKey)[idx]) + RegQueryValueExA(a0001); the result picks which constant App_WinMain passes to 0x10016490.

name: App_InitSoundSystem
summary: Initialises the sound system with the main HWND and the current directory.
evidence: Passes hWnd and GetCurrentDirectoryA to 0x100355F0, which creates the sound object dword_1046393C, initialises it when dword_10456A88 (the sound-enabled flag) is set, and loads 8-9 sound bank paths; App_WinMain calls it only if sound is enabled.

name: App_CreateRendererAndApp
summary: Creates CDx (2640 bytes) from the D3DHolder device, stores the back-buffer size and default back-buffer/depth surfaces, constructs CApp (dword_103D3C64), begins the timer period and creates helper objects.
evidence: CDx_Constructor(g_pD3DHolder->pD3D, pDevice); GetBackBuffer/GetDepthStencilSurface -> CDx_SetDefaultRenderTargets; CApp_Constructor (0x10001240); App_BeginTimerPeriod; 0x100191D0 fills unk_10456A00 up to g_pSceneState.

name: App_SetGlobal_104569C8
summary: Stores its argument in dword_104569C8.
evidence: Single store; callers Frame_Render, the state-5 step (passes 2 on error -2), 0x10017670 and 0x100D99B0.

name: App_SetGlobal_104569E8
summary: Stores its argument in dword_104569E8.
evidence: Single store; App_WinMain passes one of two constants depending on App_IsRegistryFlagSet.

name: App_SetErrorCode
summary: Stores a startup error code in dword_104569F8.
evidence: Single store; called with 2000/2001 (D3D init failure), 6/7 (OS checks), 5 and 0 on the startup/reset paths.

name: App_CreateMainWindow
summary: Registers the window class (WndProc 0x10016870), picks style and size from the window mode (1 windowed, 2 popup, 3 popup at full screen size), creates the window, removes Close from the system menu and adds a localised menu item from a resource DLL.
evidence: RegisterClassA, AdjustWindowRectEx, CreateWindowExA; mode 3 uses GetSystemMetrics(0/1); GetSystemMenu/RemoveMenu(0xF060 SC_CLOSE); LoadLibraryA + LoadStringA(0x65); App_WinMain passes the title 'FinalFantasyXI' and g_timeOfDayTintEnabled, which is really the window mode.

name: App_DestroyMainWindow
summary: Destroys the main window, unregisters its class and drains the message queue.
evidence: DestroyWindow, UnregisterClassA, PeekMessageA(PM_REMOVE) loop; called at shutdown in App_WinMain.

name: App_LoadImeUiDll
summary: Loads the IME UI DLL from a directory, resolves ImeUi_Initialize/Uninitialize/SetState and calls ImeUi_Initialize(hwnd,0).
evidence: LoadLibraryA(dir + suffix), GetProcAddress for the 'ImeUi_Initialize', 'ImeUi_Uninitialize' and 'ImeUi_SetState' strings.

name: App_UninitImeUi
summary: Calls ImeUi_Uninitialize if the IME UI DLL is loaded.
evidence: Checks hLibModule and ImeUi_Uninitialize_; the tail JUMPOUT/CRT call is a decompiler artifact (it likely frees the library).

name: App_EnableImeUi
summary: Calls ImeUi_SetState(1) if the IME UI DLL is loaded.
evidence: hLibModule and ImeUi_SetState_ non-null -> ImeUi_SetState_(1).

name: App_LoadKeyInputDll
summary: Loads the key-input helper DLL from a directory and resolves its 'KeyInput' export.
evidence: LoadLibraryA(dir + suffix) -> dword_10456A44; GetProcAddress(aKeyinput).

name: App_UnloadKeyInputDll
summary: Frees the key-input helper DLL if it is loaded.
evidence: FreeLibrary(dword_10456A44); called at shutdown after App_UninitImeUi.

name: GammaRamp_Constructor
summary: Constructs the CDx gamma-ramp object: vtable off_10329E88, requested RGB gamma 1.5 and applied RGB 1.0, then builds the initial ramps.
evidence: Stores off_10329E88; floats 1.5f at +1540..1548 and 1.0f at +1552..1560; calls GammaRamp_BuildRamps; called from CDx_Constructor (object at CDx+0x1F4).

name: GammaRamp_SetRGB
summary: Stores the three requested gamma values (+1540/+1544/+1548).
evidence: Three stores; used by Gfx_SetGammaRGB and the CXiOpening ctor/dtor (forces 1.0f, then restores).

name: GammaRamp_GetRGB
summary: Reads the three requested gamma values into out-pointers.
evidence: Reads +1540/+1544/+1548; used by Gfx_SetGammaR/G/B, Gfx_GetGammaRGB and the CXiOpening ctor.

name: GammaRamp_GetChannelSamples
summary: Returns one sample from each of the R, G and B ramp tables, scaled to floats by 1/28494.
evidence: Reads WORD entries this[122], this[374], this[642] (inside the three 256-entry ramps that start at +4) times 0.000035095749; callers include Light_ApplyTimeOfDayTint.

name: GammaRamp_BuildRamps
summary: Builds the R, G and B 256-entry gamma tables from the applied gamma values.
evidence: Calls 0x100171B0(gamma[388], this+4), (gamma[389], this+0x204), (gamma[390], this+0x404), the three D3DGAMMARAMP channels; called by the ctor and GammaRamp_ApplyIfChanged.

name: GammaRamp_ApplyIfChanged
summary: If the requested RGB gamma differs from the applied value, copies it over, rebuilds the ramps and calls SetGammaRamp (fullscreen mode 0 only).
evidence: Compares +1540.. against +1552..; GammaRamp_BuildRamps; pDevice->SetGammaRamp(0, this+4) when window mode == 0; callers App_InitScene and Frame_Render.

name: CShader_Destructor
summary: CShader destructor body: restores CShader_vtbl, releases the member at +8 and deletes the vertex shader handle at +0x10.
evidence: Stores &CShader_vtbl; vtbl+8 Release on this[2]; IDirect3DDevice8::DeleteVertexShader(this[4]); caller is CShader_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CXiOpening_Constructor
summary: Constructs CXiOpening: saves the current gamma and forces it to 1.0 when supported, copies the name, and creates the subtitle (region-dependent) and helper sub-objects.
evidence: Stores &CXiOpening_vtbl; GammaRamp_GetRGB/SetRGB(1.0f x3) when CDx+0x915 is set; strncpy 0x103; OpeningSubtitle_Constructor (0x10018A50) and 0x10018C50.

name: CXiOpening_Destructor
summary: CXiOpening destructor body: deletes the two sub-objects and restores the saved gamma values.
evidence: Stores &CXiOpening_vtbl; vtbl[0](obj,1) on this[72] and this[73]; GammaRamp_SetRGB(saved this[69..71]); caller is CXiOpening_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: OpeningSubtitle_Constructor
summary: Constructs the opening-subtitle object: picks a mesh/resource id by region (39531/55747/56167), looks it up in g_pMeshResourceMng, and loads the 'screens subtitle' font texture.
evidence: Vtable off_10329FDC; 0x100731B0(g_pMeshResourceMng, id); 0x10120450(dword_104E1BF8, aScreensSubtite); region from g_pSceneState+8; called from CXiOpening_Constructor.

name: OpeningSubtitle_Reset
summary: If the subtitle resource is loaded, resets its two progress fields (+0xC/+0x10).
evidence: Checks this[1] and *this[1]; zeroes this[3], this[4]; called by its ctor, CXiOpening_Constructor and 0x10018850.

name: Vt10329FE0_Constructor
summary: Constructs a small CXiOpening helper object (vtable off_10329FE0) and zeroes its state.
evidence: Stores off_10329FE0, zeroes +4..+0x1C and +0x38, calls 0x10018CE0; the class is not identified (created by CXiOpening_Constructor as this[73]).

name: Vt10329FE0_Reset
summary: Zeroes the helper object's state fields (+4..+0x1C, +0x34, +0x38) and returns 0.
evidence: memset(this+1,0,0x18), this[13]=this[14]=0; called by its ctor and CXiOpening_Constructor.

name: App_BeginTimerPeriod
summary: Sets the multimedia timer resolution to the smallest supported period (at least 1 ms) and records it in uPeriod.
evidence: timeGetDevCaps then timeBeginPeriod(max(wPeriodMin,1), capped at wPeriodMax); stores uPeriod; called from App_CreateRendererAndApp.

summary: Allocates a 32-byte object, constructs it with 0x10019490 and calls its virtual slot 7 (init); returns it or null.
evidence: sub_1002C890(32), 0x10019490 ctor, vtbl+28 call; App_CreateRendererAndApp fills the array unk_10456A00..g_pSceneState with these. The class is unknown.

name: CYyMotionQue_SetSlotMotion
summary: Sets motion slot a9 (0-6, 5 dwords each) of a motion queue for an actor, skipping it when the actor rejects motion, and notifies the actor for slot 0.
evidence: 0x10084620(actor) / actor vtbl+512 check; a9 <= 6; 0x1001ACB0(this+5*a9, ...motion params, floats); actor vtbl+508(0) for slot 0; callers include CXiSkeletonActor_SetMotion; unit MotionQueue.

name: Model_CreateTranslucentTargets
summary: Creates a viewport-sized render-target texture for translucent model drawing, plus a second one when g_pEnv+24 (stereo) is set.
evidence: CDx_CreateTexture(Camera_GetViewportWidth/Height, ..., rt=1) -> pTexture and dword_10456D54; the targets are used by 0x1001D240/0x1001D3B0 under model draw 0x1002B6E0.

name: Model_BeginTranslucentPass
summary: If model alpha is below opaque, pushes the offscreen model render target (and the stereo one) with the matching depth surface and clears it, marking the pass active.
evidence: Gated on byte_10456D48 / dword_10456D4C alpha != 0x80; CDx_PushRenderTarget + CDx_EndClearBegin; CEnv_IsStereoMode; called from model draw 0x1002B6E0 after SetMaterial with an alpha color.

name: Model_TranslucentUnbindTexture
summary: When the translucent model pass applies, unbinds texture stage 0 and returns 1.
evidence: Same alpha gate as Model_BeginTranslucentPass; CDx_SetTexture(0, NULL); caller is 0x1002B6E0.

name: Model_CompositeTranslucentPass
summary: Ends the translucent model pass: draws the offscreen texture as a full-target quad tinted by the model alpha colour with alpha blending, including a stereo copy, then restores Z/alpha states.
evidence: Builds 4 XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|TEX1 vertices sized from CDx_GetRenderTargetTop with color dword_10456D4C; SRCALPHA blend, Z off; SetVertexShader(324); CDx_DrawPrimitiveUP(TRIANGLESTRIP); restores ALPHAREF 96 / ALPHAFUNC 8; clears the active flag.
